entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number?
Sarah Jenkins, order 994-5821. Just tell me, yes or no, can I return it?
I understand you'd like a direct answer, Ms. Jenkins. To make sure I get you the right one, can I just ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
No fault. I just **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy** for a resolution I'm not keeping, and I simply **don't use it**.
Okay, thank you for that information. I see your order was delivered 18 days ago. Let me just quickly check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, I've got it pulled up. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. So yes, I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh. Really? That's great. I was worried I'd missed the window and would have to try and find some **resale** site.

No need for that. I've just emailed a pre-paid shipping label to you. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it at a post office. Your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days of us receiving the item.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Ms. Jenkins. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
